career_ladder.note: CTET is the mandatory statutory eligibility examination conducted by CBSE under Section 23(1) of the RTE Act and NCTE guidelines for recruitment as teachers in Central Government schools (Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan - KVS, Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti - NVS, Central Tibetan Schools, and schools under the administrative control of UTs including Delhi). Qualifying CTET enables direct recruitment to Primary Teacher (PRT, Level 6) and Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT, Level 7) cadres.

exam_scheme.note: CTET comprises two objective pen-and-paper (OMR-based) multiple choice test papers of 2.5 hours (150 minutes) duration each. Paper I is for candidates intending to teach Classes I to V (Primary Stage), and Paper II is for candidates intending to teach Classes VI to VIII (Elementary Stage). Candidates intending to teach both levels appear for both papers. There is no negative marking. Qualifying standard is 60% (90/150 marks) for General and 55% (82.5/150 marks) for SC/ST/OBC/differently-abled candidates; certificates are valid for life.

financial_package.note: Compensation for Primary Teachers (PRT) recruited via CTET eligibility under Central Government autonomous school organizations (KVS, NVS, Central Tibetan Schools) and UT administrations under 7th CPC rules.
financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Table 5 (Civilian Employees), Government of India
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Level 6 entry basic pay (₹35,400) with 58% Dearness Allowance across major regional posting categories (X/Y/Z tiers); in-hand factors in standard 10% NPS Tier-I contribution (basic + DA) and central welfare deductions.
official_perks: Residential school quarters / House Rent Allowance (27%/18%/9% by city classification)
Transport allowance with applicable Dearness Allowance
Medical facilities and reimbursement under Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) / KVS Medical Scheme
Children Education Allowance (CEA) and hostel subsidy provisions
Defined contribution pension benefits under the National Pension System (NPS)
